source: User meet.md ?1 mandatory responsibility dispositions; same information supplied to both arms.

areas.name: DNS, discovery, network paths and sockets
Proxies, gateways, ingress, CDN and load balancing
API styles, HTTP versions, RPC and streams
Runtime, memory, concurrency, OS and containers
DML/DQL, ORM, indexes and query plans

Messaging, event logs, CDC and async effects

coverageDispositions.meaning: The task implements or changes this area; state the specific scope and tests.
Provided by the existing environment and directly verified; cite evidence.
Not part of this task; give a concrete scope reason.
Relevant but not verified; name the missing evidence.

resultStatuses.meaning: Acceptance/test outcomes only; separate from the responsibility disposition vocabulary.

outputContract.coverageDispositions: Exactly24 entries {area,disposition,component,reason,evidence}; use one declared coverage value per area, scope mixed aspects explicitly.
outputContract.requirements: Use task requirement IDs and observable evidence

budget.convention: Count nested tools and collaboration calls; functions.exec orchestration wrappers excluded to avoid double counting; report unknown counts as unavailable.
